title: Cloud & Deployment
tagline: Ship, secure, observe, and recover real applications in the cloud
summary: A practical textbook on cloud service models, shared responsibility, regions and resilience, compute choices, DNS and HTTPS, environment configuration, release artifacts, frontend delivery, reverse proxies, managed data services, CI/CD, safe rollouts, infrastructure as code, observability, reliability, disaster recovery, cost management, supply-chain security, networking, container operations, background jobs, migrations, incident response and a production deployment capstone. Lessons emphasize explicit assumptions, failure modes, operational ownership and tested recovery rather than provider-specific magic commands.
